The deterministic current input normalizes root mtime to1700000000; original sdk_edit_prepare pinned file mtime and root mode but did not set native root mtime. File bytes, file mode, file mtime and root mode are preserved.

Measured Commit consumes own-written input from the ordinary overwrite. No cache/workload/limit is changed to fit.
